rules: Simple Mats (chip 'Simple'): solids, or a border/frame with a clean plain middle (small center logo fine). A mood tag that REPLACES Pastels/Brights; color sections kept. Amahj mats are Simple (her example).
A soft/light background with bold, saturated graphic elements (hot pink/magenta, strong black outlines, neon) reads Brights, not Pastels. Judge the overall impression, not the background color.
Chip order: colors, Neutral & Ivory, Earthy, Dark & Moody, Black & White, Simple, Pastels, Brights, Multicolor Florals, Animal Prints, Holiday, Retired.
final_sections_note: build_v5.py applies these color sections last (after the jungle/holiday_off/primary_fix crosstags), keeping each mat's mood tag (Pastels/Brights/Simple) as computed.
